messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 MULTI-GPU COLLECTIVE FAILURE detected in cluster tp4-prod. 4 tasks reporting NCCL timeout / comm init failures. Affected job ids: job-8921, job-8922, job-8923, job-8924. Autoscale alarms triggered. Link: https://infra/alerts/4183054321 :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: I'm on it. Confirming scope: are these all from the same allocation/ephemeral nodes?

ben_runtime: Yes, all four are on node ip-10-0-2-45 (ephemeral-014). Running TP+PP model pipelines, batch size 2. Likely multi-gpu communicator errors during allreduce.

carol_sre: Reactions: :eyes: Have we lost any hosts to flapping? I see two recent kubelet reconnects for that host.

alice_oncall: Collecting logs. Ben, can you drop nvidia-smi + dmesg + container logs tail here? I want Xid info and any OOMs.

ben_runtime: Pasting snippets — will redact long traces:

```
# nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY -i 0
GPU 0 Memory Usage: 14941 MiB / 16160 MiB
GPU 1 Memory Usage: 15012 MiB / 16160 MiB
GPU 2 Memory Usage: 15220 MiB / 16160 MiB
GPU 3 Memory Usage: 15188 MiB / 16160 MiB
```

```
# dmesg | tail -n 40
[15678.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[15678.123789] cuda: kernel CALLED: out-of-memory in some kernel
[15678.124000] containerd: task exit status 127 on container abc1234
```

ben_runtime: Container logs show repeated NCCL: Unexpected enqueue/dequeue timeout and then communicator abort: `NCCL WARN Allreduce`

alice_oncall: That Xid 79 + "GPU fallen off the bus" points to a driver/hardware transient. But multiple GPUs on same node failing suggests node/PCI or power. First step: isolate node and stop scheduling, then drain running workloads. Carol, can you cordon ephemeral-014?

carol_sre: Running:
```sh
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-2-45 # ephemeral-014
kubectl drain ip-10-0-2-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Cordon done, drain in progress. Notifying autoscaler to avoid replacing with new ephemeral until triage.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: drain initiated for node ip-10-0-2-45 by carol_sre at 4183054337

alice_oncall: Good. For active jobs: Ben, can we trigger an immediate fallback to single-GPU variant for the affected customers (model-pin to gpt-slim-1) so inference continues with degraded throughput? We should avoid retries that reattach to the failed communicator.

ben_runtime: Yes — applying pin via routing rule:
```json
{"route": "/models/large-gen", "fallback_model": "gpt-slim-1", "match": {"customer_id": ["cust-9","cust-12"]}}
```
Rule applied, traffic shifted. Notifying CS.

eve_csm: Noted. Two customers (cust-9 and cust-12) are reporting 5-10% increased latency and occasional 502s. I'm sending a short customer note: "We are mitigating and have shifted to a fallback model; you may see increased latency; full service resuming ASAP."

dmitri_ml: For triage: collect NCCL debug logs and set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 on restart to avoid hangs. Also capture GDB backtrace if a container core is available.

alice_oncall: Agreed. Ben, stop automatic retries on the job controller to avoid cascade. Also capture checkpoint/kv-cache state for potential resume.

ben_runtime: Executing safe restart plan: 1) stop affected containers 2) snapshot logs to s3://redwood-incident/4183054321/ 3) restart nvidia-persistenced and kubelet 4) if instability persists, reboot host. Commands run:
```sh
kubectl delete pod -l job=job-8921 --namespace=tp4
journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 200 > /tmp/nvpd.log
aws s3 cp /tmp/nvpd.log s3://redwood-incident/4183054321/nvpd.log
systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced
systemctl restart kubelet
```

ben_runtime: After restart, early checks show GPUs come back but kernel shows intermittent Xid 79 spikes. Deciding not to return workloads to node.

carol_sre: Host marked for reprovisioning by infra. Node will be decommissioned from ephemeral pool.

alice_oncall: For immediate live mitigation: 1) cordon + drain (done) 2) shift traffic to dedicated pool in us-west-2 to reduce cross-node bandwidth (done by routing) 3) apply NCCL env fallbacks on other nodes: `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` for now to avoid IB fabric issues, and `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1`. Ben, push that as a temporary config to the runtime config group.

ben_runtime: Pushing runtime config update: added env overrides to tp4-prod pool. Will propagate to new pods only.

alice_oncall: Customer impact summary for ops channel: Partial degraded throughput for 2 customers, transient 502s observed for ~9 minutes before fallback. No data exfiltration. System-level health now stable; we are blocking node from rejoin and reprovisioning.

eve_csm: Sent update to affected customers: "We observed multi-GPU hardware errors in one of our ephemeral hosts and shifted your traffic to a fallback model. You may see slightly higher latency. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and timeline."

dmitri_ml: Post-incident asks: collect nvmes and PCI traces from node, capture core dumps from the crashed container images, gather CUDA driver version + kernel + docker/runtime versions. We should check for any correlated driver rollouts in the past 72 hours.

carol_sre: I'm attaching the core list and upload links (shortened): s3://redwood-incident/4183054321/cores and s3://redwood-incident/4183054321/dmesg.txt

alice_oncall: On-call handoff: I will stay for another 30 minutes to confirm customer routes healthy, then hand to ben_runtime for full remediation and postmortem. Ben, you'll take ownership of the followup and RCA?

ben_runtime: I’ll take it. Will coordinate with infra to reprovision pool, run hardware diagnostics on ephemeral-014, and draft RCA. Tentative owner: ben_runtime, coowner: carol_sre, reviewer: dmitri_ml.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Incident state moved to "mitigated" at 4183054375. Auto-snooze configured for 1h.

alice_oncall: Final notes before handoff: - No persistent customer data loss - Fallback model in place for affected customers - Node reprovisioning underway - Postmortem required, include timeline and decision to fallback, and mitigation knobs we toggled (NCCL_IB_DISABLE, NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING, cordon/drain).

ben_runtime: Acknowledged, will create postmortem ticket PMT-5341 and link logs.

eve_csm: I'll follow up with customers after RCA draft.

carol_sre: Handoff complete. I'm available if infra needs access to the node before reprovisioning.

alice_oncall: Handing off to ben_runtime at 4183054387.

ben_runtime: Took ownership. Thanks all.
